# Original UMF domain-pack schema fixtures

The archive retains the exact UTF-8 ontology bytes for all21 `format: umf` schema entries in DocumentDrivenDX/umf commit `cbb6fb8718aad59fd2061b62d12976387570db2f`. Source paths and SHA-256 digests are included. No source datasets are bundled. The256 TableSpec entries are excluded, including files located under directories named `umf`.

The public registration test covers original catalog preparation, acceptance, commit and idempotent retry. It does not imply mutation or query coverage for every model shape, or support for every valid UMF schema.
